description: Make a local copy of a master page object on page_id so it can be edited there. parent_item_id must lie on a master spread (take it from get_page_state on a master page). Returns frame_id of the new local object.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

page_id.description: Document page that shows the master item.

parent_item_id.description: Object id on the master spread.

name: override_parent_item_on_page
title: Override a master item
